lines.q: Which is taller, the Eiffel Tower or the Great Pyramid?
lines.a: The Eiffel Tower! Three hundred thirty metres, more than twice the pyramid.

lines.q: The Statue of Liberty or Big Ben's tower?
lines.a: Big Ben's tower! Ninety six metres, just beating Lady Liberty with her pedestal.

lines.q: Tokyo Skytree or the CN Tower?
lines.a: Tokyo Skytree! Six hundred thirty four metres, the tallest tower in the world.

lines.q: Last one. Christ the Redeemer or the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
lines.a: Pisa! About fifty six metres. Christ the Redeemer is thirty eight, pedestal included. Think you can get all four? Go again!
